name: Oyster Rarebit
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: ½ lb. soft mild cheese, cut in small pieces

steps: Clean, parboil, and drain oysters, reserving liquor; then remove and discard tough muscle.
Melt butter, add cheese and seasonings; as cheese melts, add gradually oyster liquor, and eggs slightly beaten.
As soon as mixture is smooth, add soft part of oysters.
Serve on zephyrettes or bread toasted on one side, rarebit being poured over untoasted side.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
